test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His family lives _______ Mahu in Madhya Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is '**at**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**at**" is used to indicate a specific place or location.
 
• In this context, "**at** Mahu" specifies the location where his family lives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"His family lives **at**__ Mahu in Madhya Pradesh."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "on"** is incorrect because it is not used for indicating a specific location in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "of"** is incorrect; it indicates belonging or possession, not location.
 
• **Option 4: "by"** is incorrect because it indicates proximity rather than a specific location.
